\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 234-237 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R242-first-pass-words-from-chapters-234-237}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for useless and successful.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item left, straight, upside down, the middle, a corner
  \item up, down, ahead, behind, inside
  \item half, whole, double, separate, round
  \item square, triangular, narrow, shallow, stale
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Left? (\textbf{\hi{बायाँ}}, \emph{bāyā̃}.) Straight? (\textbf{\hi{सीधा}}, \emph{sīdhā}.) Upside down? (\textbf{\hi{उल्टा}}, \emph{ulṭā}.) The middle? (\textbf{\hi{बीच}}, \emph{bīc}.) A corner? (\textbf{\hi{कोना}}, \emph{konā}.) Up? (\textbf{\hi{ऊपर}}, \emph{ūpar}.) Down? (\textbf{\hi{नीचे}}, \emph{nīce}.) Ahead? (\textbf{\hi{आगे}}, \emph{āge}.) Behind? (\textbf{\hi{पीछे}}, \emph{pīche}.) Inside? (\textbf{\hi{अंदर}}, \emph{andar}.) Half? (\textbf{\hi{आधा}}, \emph{ādhā}.) Whole? (\textbf{\hi{पूरा}}, \emph{pūrā}.) Double? (\textbf{\hi{दुगना}}, \emph{dugnā}.) Separate? (\textbf{\hi{अलग}}, \emph{alag}.) Round? (\textbf{\hi{गोल}}, \emph{gol}.) Square? (\textbf{\hi{चौकोर}}, \emph{caukor}.) Triangular? (\textbf{\hi{तिकोना}}, \emph{tikoṇā}.) Narrow? (\textbf{\hi{संकरा}}, \emph{saṅkarā}.) Shallow? (\textbf{\hi{उथला}}, \emph{uthlā}.) Stale? (\textbf{\hi{बासी}}, \emph{bāsī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 238-242 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R242-second-pass-words-from-chapters-238-242}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for raw and lukewarm.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item raw, lukewarm, dry, sticky, rough
  \item shiny, hazy, deserted, crowded, inhabited
  \item modern, ancient, local, foreign, local
  \item government, private, free, valuable, unusual
  \item ordinary, special, famous, useless, successful
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Raw? (\textbf{\hi{कच्चा}}, \emph{kaccā}.) Lukewarm? (\textbf{\hi{गुनगुना}}, \emph{gungunā}.) Dry? (\textbf{\hi{रूखा}}, \emph{rūkhā}.) Sticky? (\textbf{\hi{चिपचिपा}}, \emph{cipcipā}.) Rough? (\textbf{\hi{खुरदुरा}}, \emph{khurdurā}.) Shiny? (\textbf{\hi{चमकदार}}, \emph{camakdār}.) Hazy? (\textbf{\hi{धुंधला}}, \emph{dhũdhlā}.) Deserted? (\textbf{\hi{सुनसान}}, \emph{sunsān}.) Crowded? (\textbf{\hi{भीड़भाड़}}, \emph{bhīṛbhāṛ}.) Inhabited? (\textbf{\hi{आबाद}}, \emph{ābād}.) Modern? (\textbf{\hi{आधुनिक}}, \emph{ādhunik}.) Ancient? (\textbf{\hi{प्राचीन}}, \emph{prācīn}.) Local? (\textbf{\hi{स्थानीय}}, \emph{sthānīya}.) Foreign? (\textbf{\hi{विदेशी}}, \emph{videśī}.) Local? (\textbf{\hi{देसी}}, \emph{desī}.) Government? (\textbf{\hi{सरकारी}}, \emph{sarkārī}.) Private? (\textbf{\hi{निजी}}, \emph{nijī}.) Free? (\textbf{\hi{मुफ़्त}}, \emph{muft}.) Valuable? (\textbf{\hi{क़ीमती}}, \emph{kīmtī}.) Unusual? (\textbf{\hi{अनोखा}}, \emph{anokhā}.) Ordinary? (\textbf{\hi{साधारण}}, \emph{sādhāraṇ}.) Special? (\textbf{\hi{ख़ास}}, \emph{khās}.) Famous? (\textbf{\hi{मशहूर}}, \emph{maśhūr}.) Useless? (\textbf{\hi{बेकार}}, \emph{bekār}.) Successful? (\textbf{\hi{कामयाब}}, \emph{kāmyāb}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
